title: The Smoking Mountain
text: The mountain ahead is smoking, its slopes black and cracked, the air thick with sulphur. Dragons nest in its warmth; you can see their shapes on the ledges. The path goes over its shoulder, right past them.

options.label: Go over the shoulder past the nests, hoping the dragons are asleep.

outcomes.text: You get over choking on ash, every kit black with it.
A nest sits on the path, and its dragon is in it.

options.label: The sharpest finds the old lava tubes and leads you through the mountain's belly.

outcomes.text: You pass through the hot dark and out the far side, pockets full of glowing stone.

options.label: Go round the long way; no path past dragons is worth taking.

outcomes.text: You lose days, and the smoke on the horizon watches you the whole time.
